summary: notafollower ships install-time lifecycle scripts that exfiltrate AWS/ECS IAM credentials
details: The package contains no library code beyond package.json. Its preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts execute inline `node -e` payloads that query the AWS/ECS instance metadata service at 169.254.170.2 (obtaining an IMDSv2 token and then IAM role credentials from `/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/`) and POST the retrieved credentials to a hardcoded external host with query string `real_aws_keys=1`. The destination hostname is left as the placeholder token `YOUR_COLLAB`, indicating a credential-harvesting template that runs automatically on `npm install` against any machine with reach to the AWS/ECS metadata endpoint (EC2 instances, ECS tasks, CI runners).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
